job.title: Registered Nurse - Clinical Facilitator - Newcastle/Central Coast
job.description:
First Choice Care is on the lookout for experienced RNs ready to move into teaching and education. As a Clinical Facilitator, you'll support nursing students through their placements, helping them develop practical, hands-on skills they'll carry into their careers.

Demand for facilitators has never been higher, and we're growing our team in Newcastle. If you've got the clinical background and a passion for mentoring, we want to hear from you.

About You
We're after RNs who are confident in their clinical ability and get genuine satisfaction from developing others. You'll need:
  • A minimum of 5 years' clinical experience as a Registered Nurse
  • Current, unrestricted AHPRA registration
  • A Bachelor of Nursing
  • Completion (or current enrolment) in the Clinical Facilitation: Essential Skills and Principles short course
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to liaise confidently across clinical teams, educators, and students
  • Solid written skills for student assessments and documentation
  • Cert IV in Training & Assessment, previous teaching or facilitation experience, or a completed preceptorship.

What's On Offer
  • Build your placement schedule around your own commitments
  • Professional development opportunities to grow your facilitation and teaching skills
  • Backed by a team of experienced Clinical Facilitators who can offer guidance along the way

Sound like a good fit? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now, or get in touch directly — call 1300 107 241, email facilitationadmin@firstchoicecare.com.au, or visit www.firstchoicecare.com.au.

job.title: Clinical Facilitator (Registered Nurse/Educator)
job.description:
First Choice Care is looking for experienced Registered Nurses to join our team as Clinical Facilitators, supporting nursing students through their clinical placements.
Demand for facilitators is high right now, and we're recruiting across Brisbane, Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast to keep up with it.
This is a good fit if you've got solid clinical experience under your belt and want to put it toward teaching, mentoring and assessing the next generation of nurses.

About you
  • Minimum 5 years' clinical experience as a Registered Nurse
  • Unrestricted AHPRA registration
  • Bachelor of Nursing degree
  • Strong communication skills, and confidence guiding and assessing students
  • Strong written skills for completing student assessments and evaluations
  • Previous experience in Clinical Facilitation, teaching or training (desirable)
What we offer
  • A supportive team environment with genuine investment in your professional development
  • The chance to build strong relationships with universities and education providers
  • Ongoing mentoring and guidance from our established Clinical Facilitators
If you're ready to help train the next generation of nurses, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now, call 1300 107 241, email facilitationadmin@firstchoicecare.com.au, or visit www.firstchoicecare.com.au.

job.title: Registered Nurses - General Medical and Surgical
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Take your career further with First Choice Care as a General Medical or Surgical Registered Nurse. You’ll work across leading Redlands hospitals, making a true impact on patient care every shift. Enjoy the flexibility to choose AM, PM, or Night Duty shifts that fit your lifestyle- perfect for balancing work and personal commitments. Earn excellent pay rates of up to $143 per hour (level dependant) plus superannuation and employee perks.

What’s in it for you?
  • Competitive Pay: Get rewarded for your skills, with higher rates for your essential work.
  • Flexible Shifts: Match your roster to your lifestyle and choose your preferred hospitals via our intuitive app.
  • More Opportunities: Access a wide variety of shifts, thanks to our extensive client network.
  • Weekly Payments: Count on regular, reliable income every week.
  • 24/7 Support: Enjoy clinical, allocations and wellbeing assistance whenever you need it (including EAP services).
  • Free Uniform: Designed by our nurses, for our nurses.
  • Exclusive Benefits: Access perks like Fitness Passport, training discounts and referral rewards.
Who we’re looking for

We’re seeking experienced and dedicated Medical or Surgical Registered Nurses who meet the following requirements:
  • Bachelor of Nursing
  • Current AHPRA registration
  • 12 months recent experience
  • Work rights in Australia
  • A valid Employment National Police Check
  • Up-to-date vaccinations
About First Choice Care

First Choice Care is one of Australia’s leading staffing agencies, specialising in aged care, healthcare and clinical facilitation. With over 20 years of experience, we recruit for casual shifts, short-term contracts and permanent roles across more than 700 public and private facilities nationwide. Committed to supporting our team every step of the way, we are also proud to be part of the PeopleIN network- Australia’s largest talent solutions provider.

Ready for a role that works for you? Apply today and experience more choice, more flexibility, and more rewards with First Choice Care.
